decisions.disk_self_protection: Do NOT queue all 5 image-modifying watchdogs in parallel — that's how the original 26 GB build-cache problem was created. One image-modifying task per zone at a time. Verify free disk ≥ 15 GB before each rebuild (watchdog-1 enforces this once shipped).

lessons_encoded.L1: When an incident response sprint generates a hardening backlog, pivot to a new sprint for the hardening campaign — don't accumulate watchdogs under the incident sprint. Clean cognitive separation.
lessons_encoded.L2: Symmetric trivial fixes flagged during one watchdog's implementation become candidate next watchdogs automatically (watchdog-7 came from watchdog-2's audit block).
lessons_encoded.L3: Disk-relief enables image-modifying hardening tasks immediately — don't defer once headroom is available, because disk re-fills under normal operation.
lessons_encoded.L4: RCA-phase-2 can reframe the incident scope retroactively. The 04:32–19:59Z 'gap' was not an outage at all — staged deployment timing. This collapses the hypothesis bench and prevents unnecessary watchdog expansion.
